blocks.text: Yeh chapter 22 (Biostatistics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define biostatistics. Describe its key components. (4 marks)
(Biostatistics ki definition likhein. Is ke ahem components bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Biostatistics: aik scientific shoba jo statistical methods aur techniques ko biological, medical aur sehat ke data par lagata hai; is mein data jama karna, pesh karna, analysis aur interpretation shamil hai taa ke ba-maani nataij niklein.

Ahem components:
1. Study design aur experimental planning: research ka sawal, maqasid tay karna aur hypothesis test karne ke liye experiments ya observational studies ki tarteeb; population chunna, variables tay karna, randomization, confounding factors control karna aur munasib sample size nikalna. Is se validity, reliability aur be-laag nataij milte hain.
2. Data collection: primary data (experiments, surveys, interviews, observations, clinical trials) aur secondary data (published research, medical records, government reports, databases).
3. Data management aur processing: analysis se pehle data ko baqaida tarteeb dena aur durusti yaqeeni banana; raazdari aur integrity ke saath cleaning, coding aur storage.
4. Data analysis: khulasa, bayan aur nataij nikalne ki statistical techniques; descriptive statistics (mean, median, mode, standard deviation) aur inferential statistics (hypothesis testing, regression analysis, modelling).
5. Interpretation of results: nataij ko ba-maani biological ya sehat ke nataij mein badalna, context, hudood aur mafrozat dekhte hue.
6. Presentation aur communication: charts, graphs aur saaf zabaan, scientific, medical aur aam audience ke liye; shaffaf reporting taa ke reproducibility aur bharosa ho.

book_ref.quote: Proper study design ensures validity, reliability, and unbiased results.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the applications of biostatistics in clinical trials, genetics and genomics, bioinformatics and healthcare quality control. (4 marks)
(Clinical trials, genetics aur genomics, bioinformatics aur healthcare quality control mein biostatistics ke istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Clinical trials aur medical research: studies design karne aur data ke analysis ka dhancha deti hai taa ke nataij durust aur qabil-e-bharosa hon. Biostatisticians nayi dawaon, ilaj aur medical devices ki hifazat aur asar jaanchte hain, jis se saboot par mabni faisle hote hain.
2. Genetics aur genomics: complex genetic data ka analysis kar ke genes aur bimariyon ka taluq, wirasat ke patterns aur genetic farq samajhti hai. Personalized medicine mein zaroori hai, jahan ilaj fard ki genetic profile ke mutabiq hota hai taa ke asar barhe aur nuqsandeh asraat kam hon.
3. Bioinformatics: genomics aur proteomics ke bare datasets ka analysis; algorithms aur models se complex data ki tashreeh hoti hai jo dawa ki daryaft, tashkhees aur personalized ilaj ke liye zaroori hai.
4. Healthcare quality control: statistical tools se diagnostic tests ki durusti, mareezon ke nataij aur procedures ki yaksaaniyat jaanchi jati hai, jis se dekh bhaal ka mayaar barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Biostatistics plays a crucial role in clinical trials and medical research

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain how biostatistics is used in public health: epidemiology, public health policy, environmental health and controlling epidemics. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke public health mein biostatistics kaise istemal hoti hai: epidemiology, public health policy, environmental health aur wabaon par qaboo.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Epidemiology: population mein bimariyon ke phailao aur asbaab ki tehqeeq, bimari ke phailne ka tareeqa, risk factors aur hifazati iqdamat ka asar; bimari ke rujhanat ki modelling se wabaon par qaboo.
2. Public health policy: population ke sehat data aur health programs ka jaiza; kamzor groups aur na-barabariyan pehchan kar policymakers ko barabari wale iqdamat ke liye saboot.
3. Environmental health: pollution aur toxins ka sehat par asar jaanchna; nuqsandeh exposures pehchanna aur qawaneen aur hifazati hikmat-e-amli ki rehnumai.
4. Wabaon par qaboo: bimari ka phailao dekhna, mortality rates ka andaza aur khatre wali population pehchanna; yeh foran analysis outbreaks rokne ki hikmat-e-amli batata hai.
Is ke ilawa health programs (immunization mohimein, sehat ki taleem) ka jaiza, healthcare ki rukawatein pehchanna, aur health risk assessment aur demography ke liye paidaish, amwaat aur bimari ke phailao ka analysis.

book_ref.quote: Biostatistics is instrumental in shaping public health policy

blocks.prompt:
4 A biologist recorded the masses of eggs laid by six hens of the same breed: 52 g, 58 g, 61 g, 55 g, 60 g and 50 g. Calculate the mean egg mass, showing each step. (4 marks)
(Aik biologist ne aik hi nasal ki chhe murghiyon ke andon ka wazan record kiya: 52 g, 58 g, 61 g, 55 g, 60 g aur 50 g. Har qadam dikha kar mean wazan nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Ungrouped data ka formula Mean = Σx/n lagayein: qeematein jama karein, gin lein, phir taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: A biologist measured the average weight of a specific species of bird in a park.

blocks.prompt:
5 The lengths of 20 leaves are grouped as: 0–4 cm (2 leaves), 4–8 cm (7), 8–12 cm (8), 12–16 cm (3). Calculate the mean leaf length. (4 marks)
(20 patton ki lambai is tarah grouped hai: 0–4 cm (2 patte), 4–8 cm (7), 8–12 cm (8), 12–16 cm (3). Patton ki mean lambai nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har class ka midpoint xᵢ nikalein, frequency fᵢ se zarb dein, products jama karein aur Σfᵢ se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: Step 4: Sum the products of midpoints and frequencies.

blocks.prompt:
6 Define median. Write the steps to calculate it for an odd and an even number of values. (4 marks)
(Median ki definition likhein. Taaq aur juft tadaad ki qeematon ke liye is ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Median: central tendency ka measure jo tarteeb di gayi data ki darmiyani qeemat hai. Population size, bimari ke phailao ya jism ki pemaishon mein, jahan data normal na ho, yeh behtar markazi qeemat deta hai. Is ka koi aik formula nahi; yeh qadamon se nikalta hai:

1. Data ko barhti ya ghatti tarteeb mein lagayein.
2. Qeematon ki kul tadaad (n) ginein.
3. Agar n taaq ho to median ((n + 1)/2)th position wali qeemat hai. Kitab ki misaal: 5 paudon mein position (5 + 1)/2 = 3rd.
4. Agar n juft ho to median (n/2)th aur (n/2 + 1)th positions ka average hai; pehle dono qeematein jama, phir 2 se taqseem. Misaal: 6 janwaron mein 3rd aur 4th, (330 + 400)/2 = 365 kg.

book_ref.quote: it provides a better representation of the central tendency in cases like population size

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the median in each case. (i) The numbers of seeds in nine pods are 14, 9, 17, 12, 20, 11, 15, 13, 18. Find the median. (ii) The resting heart rates (beats/min) of ten frogs are 31, 27, 35, 24, 29, 38, 33, 26, 30, 36. Find the median. (4 marks)
(Har soorat mein median nikalein. (i) Nau phaliyon mein beejon ki tadaad 14, 9, 17, 12, 20, 11, 15, 13, 18 hai. Median nikalein. (ii) Das mendakon ki aaram ki halat mein dil ki dhadkan (beats/min) 31, 27, 35, 24, 29, 38, 33, 26, 30, 36 hai. Median nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har set ko tarteeb dein, n ginein, phir taaq ka qaida ((n + 1)/2) ya juft ka qaida (n/2 aur n/2 + 1 ki qeematon ka average) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Step 1: Arrange the dataset in ascending or descending order.

blocks.prompt:
8 Answer the following about the mode. (i) Define mode with a biological example. (ii) How is the mode found for ungrouped and for grouped data? (4 marks)
(Mode ke baare mein jawab dein. (i) Mode ki definition biological misaal ke saath likhein. (ii) Ungrouped aur grouped data mein mode kaise nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Mode: woh qeemat ya qeematein jo data mein sab se zyada baar aayein. Biology mein yeh sample ki sab se aam khasiyat batata hai, maslan paude par phoolon ki sab se aam tadaad, beejon ka aam size ya janwaron ka aam wazan.

(ii) Ungrouped data: koi khaas formula nahi. Data tarteeb dein, har qeemat ki frequency ginein aur sab se zyada aane wali qeemat chunein (kitab ki misaal mein 50 cm chaar baar aata hai, is liye mode 50 cm).
Grouped data: modal class (sab se zyada frequency wali class) pehchanein, phir
Mode = l + (fm − f₁) / [(fm − f₁) + (fm − f₂)] × h
jahan l = modal class ki lower boundary, fm = modal class ki frequency, f₁ = pehle wali class ki frequency, f₂ = baad wali class ki frequency, h = class width.

book_ref.quote: There is no specific formula to calculate mode in ungrouped data.

blocks.prompt:
9 The lengths of 60 fish in a pond are grouped as: 10–15 cm (6), 15–20 cm (14), 20–25 cm (22), 25–30 cm (12), 30–35 cm (6). Calculate the mode. (4 marks)
(Talaab ki 60 machhliyon ki lambai is tarah grouped hai: 10–15 cm (6), 15–20 cm (14), 20–25 cm (22), 25–30 cm (12), 30–35 cm (6). Mode nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Modal class pehchanein, l, fm, f₁, f₂ aur h parhein aur grouped data ke mode formula mein rakhein.

book_ref.quote: The class interval (30-40) Class III is the modal class with the highest frequency (18).

steps: Modal class = 20–25 cm (sab se zyada frequency, 22)

blocks.prompt:
10 What is standard deviation? Explain what low and high standard deviations show, with reference to normal curves, and give its uses in biology. (4 marks)
(Standard deviation kya hai? Normal curves ke hawale se kam aur zyada standard deviation ka matlab samjhayein aur biology mein is ke istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Standard deviation (σ): yeh naapti hai ke data mean ke muqable mein kitna bikhra hua hai.
σ = √[Σ(xᵢ − µ)² / N], jahan xᵢ = har data point, µ = mean, N = data points ki kul tadaad.

Matlab:
1. Kam SD: data mean ke gird qareeb jama; zero ke qareeb SD ka matlab points mean ke bohat qareeb.
2. Zyada SD: data zyada phaila hua, mean se door.
3. Normal curves: curve (a) zyada phaila hua, SD zyada; curve (b) mean ke gird jama, SD kam.

Qadam: mean nikalein; har point se ghatayein; har deviation ka square (negative khatam, bare deviations numayan); squares ka average (variance); square root.

Biology mein istemal: pemaishon ki variability jaanchna, jaise paudon ki growth rates, sample mein enzymes ki concentration ya doosra biological data; bar charts par SD error bars.

book_ref.quote: A standard deviation close to zero indicates that data points are very close to the mean

blocks.prompt:
11 The heights of six seedlings of the same species are 12, 14, 15, 16, 18 and 21 cm. Calculate the variance and the standard deviation. (4 marks)
(Aik hi species ke chhe paudon (seedlings) ki oonchai 12, 14, 15, 16, 18 aur 21 cm hai. Variance aur standard deviation nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Mean nikalein, har point ka deviation, deviations ka square le kar jama karein, N se taqseem kar ke variance, phir square root.

book_ref.quote: A biologist studied the heights of 9 different plants of the same species.

blocks.prompt:
12 Answer about the range. (i) Define range and state what a large and a small range indicate. (ii) The lengths (cm) of eight earthworms are 18, 25, 21, 30, 16, 27, 23, 19. Calculate the range. (4 marks)
(Range ke baare mein jawab dein. (i) Range ki definition likhein aur batayein ke bari aur chhoti range kya zahir karti hai. (ii) Aath kenchuon ki lambai (cm) 18, 25, 21, 30, 16, 27, 23, 19 hai. Range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Range data ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti qeemat ka farq hai; yeh variability ki sab se saada shakal hai. Bari range zyada phailao (points zyada bikhre); chhoti range ka matlab points markazi qeemat ke gird qareeb. Range = Xmax − Xmin.
(ii) Data tarteeb dein, sab se bari aur chhoti qeemat lein aur bari mein se chhoti ghatayein.

book_ref.quote: Step 4: Subtract the maximum value from the minimum value to calculate the range.

blocks.prompt:
13 Define percentile. Explain the quartiles and describe how a percentile is calculated from the rank formula. (4 marks)
(Percentile ki definition likhein. Quartiles samjhayein aur rank formula se percentile nikalne ka tareeqa bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Percentile: data ki woh qeemat jis se neeche observations ka diya gaya feesad hissa aaye.
1. 25th percentile = first quartile (Q1): 25% data is se neeche.
2. 50th percentile = median: 50% data is se neeche.
3. 75th percentile = third quartile (Q3): 75% data is se neeche.
Percentiles biological data ki distribution samajhne mein madad dete hain, chahe skewed ho ya normal.

Hisaab:
1. Data barhti tarteeb mein lagayein.
2. Observations (n) ginein.
3. Rank R = (P/100) × (n + 1), jahan P matloob percentile hai.
4. Agar R poora adad ho to Rth position wali qeemat percentile hai. Warna (maslan 4.4) do qareebi ranks mein interpolation: 4th ki qeemat + 0.4 × (5th ki qeemat − 4th ki qeemat).
5. Matlab: maslan 40th percentile 168.8 ka matlab 40% observations 168.8 ya us se kam hain.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, the 50th percentile, or the median, is the value below which 50% of the data points lie

blocks.prompt:
14 The ordered masses (g) of 12 newborn mice are 30, 32, 35, 36, 38, 40, 41, 43, 45, 47, 50, 52. Calculate the first quartile (25th percentile) and the third quartile (75th percentile). (4 marks)
(12 naumolood choohon ka tarteeb wala wazan (g) 30, 32, 35, 36, 38, 40, 41, 43, 45, 47, 50, 52 hai. First quartile (25th percentile) aur third quartile (75th percentile) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: P = 25 aur P = 75 ke liye rank R = (P/100)(n + 1) nikalein; R poora adad nahi, is liye do qareebi qeematon mein interpolation karein.

book_ref.quote: For example, if it lies between 4th and 5th data points, percentile value=

steps: n = 12 (data pehle se barhti tarteeb mein)
blocks.final_answer: Q1 = 35.25 g; Q3 = 46.5 g (25% choohe 35.25 g ya kam, 75% choohe 46.5 g ya kam)

blocks.prompt:
15 Define a bar chart. Describe the steps of making a bar chart, using the insect diversity study as the example. (4 marks)
(Bar chart ki definition likhein. Keeron ki iqsaam ki study ki misaal se bar chart banane ke qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bar chart: categorical data ki mustateel bars wali tasweeri shakal jis mein bar ki lambai ya oonchai qeemat ke mutanasib ho; categories ka muqabla karne ke liye. Categories x-axis par, qeematein y-axis par, bars amoodi ya ufuqi.

Qadam (keeron ki study: jungle mein aik mahine paanch species ke afraad gine gaye):
1. Maqsad aur data: paanch species ki abundance ka muqabla; categorical variable = species (ladybug, ant, butterfly, bee, dragonfly); numerical variable = gine gaye afraad.
2. Axes tay karein: x-axis = species; y-axis = gine gaye afraad.
3. Numerical axis scale karein: sab se bari qeemat 120 (ants), is liye y-axis 0 se 140 tak 20 ke izafe se.
4. Bars banayein: ladybug 45, ant 120, butterfly 30, bee 75, dragonfly 20, barabar chaurai aur yaksaan faasle par.
5. Labels aur title: title 'Insect species abundance in local forest'; x-axis 'Insect species'; y-axis 'Number of individuals'; legend rangon ka matlab batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Purpose: To visually compare the abundance of five different insect species.

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the steps to sketch error bars on a bar chart, using the bean plants grown in three light conditions as the example. (4 marks)
(Teen roshni ke halaat mein ugaye gaye bean ke paudon ki misaal se bar chart par error bars banane ke qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Error bars bar chart par woh nishanat hain jo bar wale mean ke gird data ki variability ya ghair-yaqeeni dikhate hain.

Misaal: bean ke paude Group A (kam roshni), B (darmiyani) aur C (zyada roshni), har group mein teen paude, chaar haftay baad naape: A 10, 11, 9 cm; B 14, 16, 15 cm; C 18, 20, 19 cm.

1. Har group ka mean: A = 10 cm, B = 15 cm, C = 19 cm. Bars in oonchaiyon tak banaye jaate hain.
2. Phailao nikalein: SD error bars ke liye har group ki SD = √(2/3) ≈ 0.82 cm (taqreeban 1 cm); range error bars ke liye A 9–11, B 14–16, C 18–20 (range 2, range error ±1).
3. Error bars banayein: SD error bars mean (bar ke upar) se shuru ho kar 1 SD upar aur neeche (A 9 se 11, B 14 se 16, C 18 se 20); range error bars har group ke minimum se maximum tak.
4. Har amoodi error bar ke dono siron par ufuqi cap lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Error bars are graphical elements placed on bar charts

blocks.prompt:
17 Wheat seedlings were grown with three fertilizers (three plants each). Heights (cm): Fertilizer A 8, 10, 12; B 14, 17, 17; C 20, 22, 24. For each group find the mean, the range, the range error (± range/2), the standard deviation (σ, dividing by N) and the limits of the range error bar. (4 marks)
(Gandum ke paude teen fertilizers ke saath ugaye gaye (har group mein teen paude). Oonchai (cm): Fertilizer A 8, 10, 12; B 14, 17, 17; C 20, 22, 24. Har group ka mean, range, range error (± range/2), standard deviation (σ, N se taqseem) aur range error bar ki hudood nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Mean = Σx/n; range = max − min; range error = range/2; σ = √[Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N]; range error bar minimum se maximum tak.

book_ref.quote: Table: Statistical summary of plant measurements

steps: A ki SD: deviations −2, 0, 2; squares 4 + 0 + 4 = 8; σ = √(8/3) = 1.63 cm (C bhi yahi, 1.63 cm)
B ki SD: deviations −2, 1, 1; squares 4 + 1 + 1 = 6; σ = √(6/3) = √2 = 1.41 cm
Range error bars: A 8 se 12; B 14 se 17; C 20 se 24 cm, har aik ke dono siron par cap
blocks.final_answer: Bars 10, 16 aur 22 cm par; range errors ±2, ±1.5, ±2 cm; SDs ≈ 1.63, 1.41, 1.63 cm

blocks.prompt:
18 What is a pie chart? Describe the steps of constructing a pie chart from categorical data. (4 marks)
(Pie chart kya hai? Categorical data se pie chart banane ke qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pie chart: aik gol statistical graph jo sectors (qashon) mein taqseem hota hai, har sector poore data ka aik hissa. Poora daira 100% (360°) hai aur har sector ka angle us category ke hisse ke mutanasib hai. Yeh categorical data ko poore ke hisson ki shakal mein dikhane ke liye behtareen hai, jaise cells ki iqsaam, species ki distribution ya survey ke jawabat.

Qadam (kitab ki misaal: 100 talaba ke blood types):
1. Data tarteeb dein: categories aur frequencies table mein (A 30, B 20, AB 10, O 40).
2. Tamam frequencies jama kar ke total (30 + 20 + 10 + 40 = 100).
3. Har sector angle = (category value / total value) × 360°: A 108°, B 72°, AB 36°, O 144° (kul 360°).
4. Chart banayein: daira banayein, reference line (radius) se shuru kar ke protractor se har angle tarteeb se, clockwise ya counter-clockwise, alag rangon ke saath.
5. Label aur title: har sector par label, zaroorat ho to legend aur aik wazeh title.

book_ref.quote: Step 3: Calculate the sector angles

blocks.prompt:
19 A survey of 200 plants in a park found 70 grasses, 50 shrubs, 30 herbs and 50 trees. Calculate the sector angle of each category for a pie chart and check the total. (4 marks)
(Aik park ke 200 paudon ke survey mein 70 grasses, 50 shrubs, 30 herbs aur 50 trees mile. Pie chart ke liye har category ka sector angle nikalein aur total check karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sector angle = (category value / total value) × 360°; tamam angles ka majmua 360° hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Use different colours/shades to differentiate each category.

blocks.prompt:
20 What is the x-axis of a data figure? Describe the steps of making an x-axis data figure of the effect of temperature on enzyme activity. (4 marks)
(Data figure ka x-axis kya hai? Temperature ke enzyme activity par asar ka x-axis data figure banane ke qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
X-axis: Cartesian coordinate system ya data figure ki ufuqi line jo baayen se daayen chalti, aksar origin (0, 0) se shuru ho kar musbat simt mein jati hai (zaroorat ho to manfi qeematein bhi). Yeh aam taur par independent variable dikhata hai aur woh buniyad deta hai jis ke muqable y-axis ka variable naapa jata hai; biology mein aksar waqt ke waqfe, species ya experimental halaat.

Qadam (enzyme activity 5, 10, 20, 30 aur 40 °C par naapi gayi):
1. Variables pehchanein: independent variable (x-axis) = temperature °C mein; dependent variable (y-axis) = enzyme activity ki rate.
2. Scale aur range: x-axis ki kam se kam aur zyada qeemat aur waqfe, yani 5 se 40 °C.
3. Axes ke labels: x-axis 'Temperature (°C)'; y-axis 'Enzyme Activity (μmol/min)'.
4. Points plot karein: (5 °C, 2), (10 °C, 4), (20 °C, 7), (30 °C, 5), (40 °C, 3) μmol/min.
5. Formatting: tick marks yaksaan faasle par aur points ko line se jodein taa ke rujhan dikhe (activity 20 °C par 7 μmol/min tak barh kar phir kam hoti hai).

book_ref.quote: Suppose we are measuring the activity of enzyme.

blocks.prompt:
21 What is experimental design? Explain the types of variables and the groups used in an experiment. (4 marks)
(Experimental design kya hai? Experiment mein istemal hone wale variables ki iqsaam aur groups samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Experimental design: kisi khayal ko test karne ke liye experiment ki ehtiyat se planning. Scientists subjects tay karte aur halaat control karte hain taa ke nataij munsifana hon; woh aik cheez badal kar doosri par asar dekhte hain taa ke hypothesis ka sahi ya ghalat hona pata chale.

Variables:
1. Independent variable: woh factor jise experimenter asar dekhne ke liye badalta hai.
2. Dependent variable: jo naapa ya dekha jaye; yeh independent variable ke jawab mein badalta hai.
3. Control variables (constants): baqi tamam factors jo poore experiment mein yaksaan rakhe jayein taa ke test munsifana ho.

Groups:
1. Control group: treatment ya independent variable ki tabdeeli nahi milti; yeh buniyad (baseline) hai jo batata hai ke independent variable waqai asar karta hai ya nahi.
2. Experimental group: test hone wala treatment, halat ya tabdeeli milti hai; is ke nataij control group se milaye jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: It serves as a baseline to compare the results of the experimental group

blocks.prompt:
22 Describe the steps of experimental design. (4 marks)
(Experimental design ke qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Sawal bayan karein: pehle experiment ka sawal; is se wazeh hota hai ke kya maloom karna hai.
2. Hypothesis banayein: research ki buniyad par, mojooda ilm ke mutabiq aap ke khayal mein kya hoga.
3. Variables pehchanein: kya badlenge (independent), kya naapenge (dependent) aur kya yaksaan rakhenge (control variables).
4. Groups banayein: control group (treatment ya tabdeeli nahi) aur experimental group (treatment ya tabdeeli milti hai).
5. Procedure ki planning: subjects kaise chune aur groups mein baante jayein, har group se kya kiya jaye, pemaish ki muddat aur kitni baar, data kaise jama ho.
6. Results ka analysis: munasib methods (average, graph ya statistical tests) se groups ke nataij milayein aur dekhein ke significant asar hai ya nahi.
7. Nataij nikalein: asal hypothesis aur sawal ke hawale se; results ki buniyad par hypothesis qabool ya radd karein.

book_ref.quote: Draw conclusions in relation to the original hypothesis and research question.

blocks.prompt:
23 Using the steps of experimental design, describe an experiment to find the effect of a high-fat diet on weight gain in albino mice. (4 marks)
(Experimental design ke qadamon ko istemal karte hue albino choohon mein high-fat diet ke wazan barhne par asar ka experiment bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Sawal: kya high-fat diet choohon mein normal diet ke muqable mein zyada wazan barhati hai?
2. Hypothesis: high-fat diet wale choohe normal diet walon se zyada wazan barhayenge.
3. Variables: independent = diet ki qisam; dependent = wazan mein izafa; control = umar, strain, jins, pinjra, mahol (roshni, temperature) aur khilane ka schedule.
4. Groups: control group = normal diet wale choohe; experimental group = high-fat diet wale choohe.
5. Procedure: umar, strain aur jins mein milte albino choohe chunein; inhein be-tarteeb (randomly) dono groups mein baantein; sab ko yaksaan halaat mein rakhein (aik jaise pinjre, roshni, temperature, nami); muqarrara muddat (maslan 8 haftay) tak diet dein; har choohe ka wazan har hafte naap kar record karein.
6. Results ka analysis: aakhir mein statistical tests ya graphs se dono groups ka average wazan ka izafa milayein.
7. Nataij: agar high-fat group mein average wazan ka statistically significant izafa ho to hypothesis sahi (diet ki qisam wazan par asar karti hai). Agar koi significant farq na ho, ya normal diet group zyada barhe, to hypothesis radd, yani doosre factors zyada kirdar ada kar sakte hain.
